root_cause.text: In `__rds_rdma_map()`, after `get_mr()` transfers ownership of the scatter-gather list and pages to the transport, the `put_user()` failure branch incorrectly freed those resources again, leading to a double-free or use-after-free scenario.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the duplicate `unpin_user_pages(pages, nr_pages)` and `kfree(sg)` calls from the `put_user()` error branch, as specified in the commit message: "Remove the duplicate unpin/free from the put_user() failure branch so that MR teardown is handled only through the existing final cleanup path." This confirms the root cause as a premature and duplicate resource release after ownership transfer.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove incorrect conditional cleanup on put_user failure that skipped cleanup when ODP was active, ensuring resources are always released via the common error path.
intent_record.what: Removed the conditional cleanup block that unpinned user pages and freed the scatter-gather list only when ODP (On-Demand Paging) was not needed, inside the error handling for put_user failure.
intent_record.how: On put_user failure, the code no longer conditionally cleans up pages and sg list based on the need_odp flag; instead, it falls through to the common out label, which should handle cleanup uniformly for all cases.
